news.headline: Earnings Update: Here's Why Analysts Just Lifted Their Nektar Therapeutics Price Target To US$153
news.summary: Following the Q2 print, the analyst consensus price target moved up to roughly $153, with the sell-side rating NKTR a Strong Buy (about 11 covering analysts, no sell ratings). B. Riley sits at $150 and Piper Sandler at $192 on the high end, leaving the consensus roughly 100% above the share price near $76.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Slides As Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Quarterly revenue fell 9.4% year over year to $10.13 million and the trailing 12-month net loss widened to roughly $157 million, keeping investor focus on burn even as the Phase 3 program ramps. Shares fell in the days after earnings despite the EPS beat and the raised year-end cash guidance.

news.headline: Nektar Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Lag, Pipeline in Focus
news.summary: Nektar posted a Q2 loss of $1.23 per share versus a consensus loss of about $2.06, a large beat, while revenue of $10.1 million slightly missed the $10.4 million estimate. The 10-Q filed the same day raised year-end 2026 cash guidance to $815-840 million, up from the prior $800-825 million range.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026, versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, with no debt and runway into Q3 2028, past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss narrowed to $40.6 million ($1.23/share); management guided ZENITH AD-3 to start by end-September 2026, 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata data for Q4 2026, a Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027 and a first BLA in 2029.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity Initiates Coverage of Nektar Therapeutics with Buy Rating and $153 Price Target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity started NKTR at Buy with a $153 target one day after the Phase 3 launch, adding to a broadly constructive sell-side. Targets remain widely dispersed, from around $80 on the cautious end to Piper Sandler's $192.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar started ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, part of a roughly 1,530-patient program across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific with a third study in treatment-experienced patients to follow. The design followed FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, and targets initial topline data in mid-2028 with a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, was guided on the Q2 call to begin by the end of September 2026. It completes the registrational package for both U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in the harder-to-treat population.

catalysts.label: EADV Congress 2026 (Vienna) - possible rezpeg data presentation
catalysts.detail: Nektar presented REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b results in a late-breaker at EADV 2025 and has a pattern of showing dermatology data at this meeting, but no accepted-abstract press release for EADV 2026 has been issued yet. Treat as a possible venue for further REZOLVE-AD maintenance or REZOLVE-AA 52-week data.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report should update cash burn against the raised year-end guidance of $815-840 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start and early enrollment, and detail preparations for the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3. Exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment data (alopecia areata)
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to presenting 24-week off-treatment data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA study in Q4 2026, to inform long-term maintenance dosing. Durability of the Treg effect after stopping drug is a key swing factor going into the alopecia areata Phase 3.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AD 52-week off-treatment data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Nektar guided to 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data in Q1 2027, complementing the maintenance data that showed durable and deepening EASI-75/90/100 responses on monthly and quarterly dosing. Relevant to the commercial case for infrequent maintenance dosing versus dupilumab and JAKs.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 study in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata in early 2027, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept data and the existing Fast Track designation. This adds a second, funded value driver alongside atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway now extends into Q3 2028, covering this readout without a further raise.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar has publicly guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in 2029, following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European filing is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Nektar is now a pure late-stage rezpeg story with the funding question largely answered: Q2 2026 (August 13) showed $1,023.4 million in cash and investments with no debt and runway into Q3 2028, comfortably past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout, and year-end 2026 cash guidance was nudged up to $815-840 million. Newsflow since the July 21 Phase 3 launch has been execution and sell-side driven rather than data driven - a big EPS beat against a small revenue miss, a consensus target lifted to roughly $153 (B. Riley $150, Piper Sandler $192) versus a share price near $76, but a stock that still slid after the print as Phase 3 spending ramps. The next real tests are the ZENITH AD-3 start by end-September and the 24-week off-treatment REZOLVE-AA data in Q4 2026; the main risk is that off-drug durability disappoints or burn accelerates, leaving a two-year gap to the mid-2028 readout with nothing but enrollment updates to support the valuation.
